{{ElectionsOH}}
The '''2018 Ohio Secretary of State election''' was held on November 6, 2018, to elect the [[Ohio Secretary of State]], concurrently with elections to the [[2018 United States Senate election in Ohio|United States Senate]], [[2018 United States House of Representatives elections in Colorado|U.S. House of Representatives]], [[2018 Ohio gubernatorial election|governor]], and other [[2018 Ohio elections|state]] and [[2018 United States elections#Local elections|local]] elections. Primary elections were held on May 8, 2018, though both the [[Republican Party (United States)|Republican]] and [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] nominees ran uncontested.<ref>{{Cite web |date=May 9, 2018 |title=Ohio Primary Election Results |url=https://www.nytimes.com/interactive/2018/05/08/us/elections/results-ohio-primary-elections.html |access-date=October 22, 2025 |website=The New York Times}}</ref>

Incumbent secretary [[Jon Husted]] was term-limited and instead was the Republican nominee for [[2018 Ohio gubernatorial election|lieutenant governor]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Icsman |first=Marilyn |last2=Couch |first2=Erin |date=October 5, 2018 |title=Ohio's Secretary of State race: Here's everything you need to know |url=https://www.cincinnati.com/story/news/2018/10/05/ohios-secretary-state-race-heres-everything-you-need-know/759561002/ |access-date=October 22, 2025 |website=The Cincinnati Enquirer}}</ref> Republican state senator [[Frank LaRose]] defeated Democratic state representative [[Kathleen Clyde]] in the general election.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Candisky |first=Catherine |date=November 6, 2018 |title=Ohio Republicans sweep statewide downticket office races |url=https://www.beaconjournal.com/story/news/politics/elections/local/2018/11/07/ohio-republicans-sweep-statewide-downticket/9126146007/ |access-date=October 22, 2025 |website=Akron Beacon Journal}}</ref>

== Republican primary ==
=== Candidates ===
==== Nominee ====
* [[Frank LaRose]], state senator from the [[Ohio's 27th senatorial district|27th]] district (2011–present)<ref>{{Cite web |last=Evans |first=Nick |date=September 28, 2018 |title=Who's Running For Ohio Secretary Of State, And What Is That Anyway? |url=https://www.wosu.org/news/2018-09-28/whos-running-for-ohio-secretary-of-state-and-what-is-that-anyway |access-date=October 22, 2025 |website=WOSU 89.7}}</ref>
==== Withdrawn ====
* [[Dorothy Pelanda]], state representative from the 86th district (2011–2019) ''(endorsed LaRose)''<ref>{{Cite web |last=Kilpatrick |first=Mary |date=October 16, 2017 |title=Dorothy Pelanda ends campaign to become Ohio's secretary of state |url=https://www.cleveland.com/open/2017/10/dorothy_pelanda_ends_campaign.html |access-date=October 22, 2025 |website=Cleveland.com}}</ref><ref name="rependorse1" />
